# Welcome to PHO Monorepo

PHO Monorepo is a powerful template for building modern Expo and Next.js applications. This template provides a solid foundation for your projects with features like:

## Key Features

- **Latest Expo SDK**: Leverage the best of the Expo ecosystem while maintaining full control over your app
- **TypeScript & TailwindCSS**: Enhanced code quality and beautiful styling
- **Multi-environment Support**: Production, Staging, and Development environments
- **Clean Project Structure**: Organized monorepo setup for better code management

## Getting Started

To get started with PHO Monorepo, clone the repository and follow the setup instructions in our documentation.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/divineniiquaye/pho-monorepo.git
cd pho-monorepo
pnpm install
```

We're excited to see what you'll build with PHO Monorepo!
